16// This header deliberately does NOT include <nlohmann/json.hpp>. The vendored single header is
17// a PRIVATE implementation detail -- CMake adds third_party/ to the PRIVATE include path and no
18// other public header names it -- so exposing it here would put a third-party type in the
19// installed API and force nlohmann onto every consumer's include path. A free-form JSON member
20// (`metadata`, `attribute_map`) is therefore raw JSON TEXT, which the caller hands to whatever
21// parser they already use. The to_json/from_json hooks live in src/management_json.hpp, which
22// is not installed.
